title: Takeshobo to Release Melt in Your Color, My Father's Lover, More Manga Digitally in English
content: Publisher Takeshobo announced on Thursday that it will launch the following manga in English: Takeshobo will release the manga in English digitally on the following platforms: Renta! , MangaPlaza , Coolmic , BookWalker , and Rakuten Kobo.
author: ANN

title: 5 Highest-Selling Manga of 2026 So Far
content: Manga continues to remain the purest way of experiencing the stories that authors intend, as even after anime adaptations continue to elevate the source material, the original manga still receives the recognition they deserve.
author: ComicBook

title: Tomb Raider King Korean-Animated Series Reveals New Character Videos, July 8 Debut
content: Kadokawa revealed the July 8 debut for the Korean-animated adaptation of artist 3B2S , storywriter Yuns (REDICE STUDIO), original storywriter SAN.G , and character designer P-crush 's Tomb Raider King webtoon on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: Invincible Actor Doesn’t Know Why He Was Recast
content: Invincible’s fourth season saw Mark fighting the Viltrumite Empire, travelling to the underworld, and struggling to keep his soul in the face of terrifying decisions made to protect his world. Unfortunately, not every cast member of the animated series will continue being a part of Grayson’s world.
author: ComicBook

title: Detective Conan, Star Detective Precure! Anime Preview Crossover Episodes in Trailer
content: The official YouTube channel for the Detective Conan anime began streaming on Thursday a promotional video for the upcoming collaboration crossover episodes with the Star Detective Precure! anime: The episode of Detective Conan airing on June 6, "Hanamaru na Answer" (The Flower Seal Answer), will feature Cure Answer.
author: ANN

title: One of Netflix’s Most Popular Anime Confirms Season 2 Release Date
content: Earlier this year, one of Netflix’s strongest anime warriors met his match, making for quite a departure following the successful fight against his father. With the first twelve episodes of this series ending on quite a cliffhanger, it turns out that anime fans won’t be waiting much longer for the show to return.
author: ComicBook

title: Dr. Stone Final Season Reveals Climax Visual Featuring Senku in a Spacesuit
content: Dr. Stone: Science Future (Season 4) Cour 3 (final) revealed a climax visual featuring Senku wearing a spacesuit. The anime premiered on April 2 , with Shuhei Matsushuita directing at TMS Entertainment. You can see the new visual below.
author: Anime Corner

title: Kindergarten Wars Anime Casts Tetsu Inada
content: The staff for the television anime of Yū Chiba 's Kindergarten WARS ( Yōchien Wars ) manga revealed on Thursday a new cast member. Tetsu Inada will voice the character Gordon, Black Kindergarten's vice-principal and school nurse.
author: ANN

title: Gachiakuta Stage Play Cancels Performances After Rudo Actor Gets Injured
content: The official website for the stage play adaptation of Kei Urana 's Gachiakuta manga announced on Wednesday that it canceled the Wednesday and Thursday performances, after lead actor Hikaru Imamaki, who portrays Rudo, injured his leg during the play's Tuesday evening performance.
author: ANN

title: Yū Shimizu's Howling Blaze Fantasy Light Novels Get Manga
content: The July issue of Kadokawa 's Comic Alive magazine revealed on Wednesday that Yū Shimizu 's Howling Blaze: Sōen no Kenshi to Fushi no Majo ( Howling Blaze: The Funeral Flame Blade & The Immortal Witch ) light novel series is inspiring a manga adaptation by koko that will launch in the magazine's next issue on June 26.
author: ANN
